title: Livestock Disease Early Detection Symptom & Vitals Schema
disclaimer: SCREENING & TRIAGE AID ONLY — NOT A VETERINARY DIAGNOSIS. Always consult a registered veterinarian for clinical examination, confirmatory testing, and treatment.

symptoms.label: Loss of appetite / off feed
symptoms.description: Animal refuses fodder, concentrate, or grazing

symptoms.label: Severe lethargy or weakness
symptoms.description: Dullness, drooping ears, reluctance or inability to stand

symptoms.label: Sudden drop in milk yield
symptoms.description: Noticeable acute decrease in daily milk production

symptoms.label: Swollen lymph nodes
symptoms.description: Visible/palpable firm lumps in front of shoulder or flank

symptoms.label: Excessive salivation / drooling
symptoms.description: Ropy strings of saliva or foaming from mouth

symptoms.label: Mouth blisters or ulcers
symptoms.description: Fluid-filled vesicles, raw sores, or peeling on tongue/gums

symptoms.label: Nasal discharge
symptoms.description: Watery, thick mucoid, or pus-like discharge from nostrils

symptoms.label: Eye (ocular) discharge
symptoms.description: Excessive tearing, cloudy eyes, or crusty discharge

symptoms.label: Persistent coughing
symptoms.description: Repeated dry or moist cough, especially on movement

symptoms.label: Labored or rapid breathing
symptoms.description: Flared nostrils, stretched neck, open-mouth or heavy abdominal breathing

symptoms.label: Throat or brisket swelling
symptoms.description: Warm, soft fluid swelling under jaw, neck, or chest brisket

symptoms.label: Bleeding from natural openings
symptoms.description: Dark unclotted blood oozing from nose, mouth, or rectum

symptoms.label: Watery or loose diarrhea
symptoms.description: Frequent watery or foul-smelling dung

symptoms.label: Blood-stained diarrhea
symptoms.description: Dark red streaks or frank blood in loose stool

symptoms.label: Left-flank abdominal bloat
symptoms.description: Tight, drum-like distension on the upper left side

symptoms.label: Stopped cud chewing (rumination)
symptoms.description: No visible rumination cycles over several hours

symptoms.label: Sweet / acetone breath odor
symptoms.description: Distinct fruity or nail-polish-like smell on breath or milk

symptoms.label: Firm skin nodules / lumps
symptoms.description: Raised round skin bumps (2-5 cm) on neck, back, or legs

symptoms.label: Hoof sores or foul rot
symptoms.description: Blisters, raw cracks, or foul-smelling decay between claws

symptoms.label: Lameness or limping
symptoms.description: Reluctance to bear weight, stiff gait, or grazing on knees

symptoms.label: Crackling muscle swelling
symptoms.description: Hot painful swelling on thigh or shoulder that crackles when pressed

symptoms.label: Hot, swollen, or painful udder
symptoms.description: Hardened, reddened, or tender udder quarter

symptoms.label: Clotted, watery, or bloody milk
symptoms.description: Visible flakes, clots, pus, or pink discoloration in milk

symptoms.label: Pale inner eyelids
symptoms.description: Whitish or washed-out lower eyelid conjunctiva (anemia sign)

URGENT_REFERRAL.label: Urgent Veterinary Referral Required
URGENT_REFERRAL.summary: High risk of rapid deterioration, fatality, zoonotic hazard, or notifiable herd outbreak. Isolate animal immediately and contact a veterinarian urgently.

VET_CONSULT.label: Prompt Veterinary Consultation (Within 24h)
VET_CONSULT.summary: Requires clinical examination and targeted veterinary therapy. Separate from healthy stock and schedule vet visit within 24 hours.

MONITOR_ROUTINE.label: Supportive Care & Scheduled Vet Review
MONITOR_ROUTINE.summary: Lower immediate mortality risk; provide supportive hygiene/isolation and arrange routine veterinary checkup if signs persist or worsen.
